keyFindings: The four current MRT-3 Makati stations are already complete in Civic Map.

Makati's 2023 three-PNR-station count describes operating-era infrastructure, but Metro Commuter service has been suspended since March 28, 2024; these should not be presented as current operating stops.
The 32 bus-stop headline cannot be safely turned into assets because Makati's current publication does not name the 32 stops.
The 2020 city transport section contains 38 jeepney-route rows, not 39: its numbering skips 36.
Guadalupe and Valenzuela ferry stations are the strongest immediate missing current transport assets.
One Ayala and the three EDSA Busway stations are useful current supplemental assets but should remain separate from Makati's older/current city denominators unless a direct crosswalk is found.
The 32 current bus stops remain a verified DEPW headline count but cannot yet be converted into named Civic Map assets.
The city count changed from 17 in 2022 to 32 in 2023 despite the 2023 exclusion of the 10 transferred barangays; the reviewed sources do not explain the counting-basis change.
DEPW's older 36 waiting-shed count is lineage evidence only and is not treated as a bus-stop roster.
Makati's three operating-era PNR stops remain non-operating in 2026 after the March 28, 2024 suspension.
Future NSCR Makati passenger stations are Buendia and EDSA; neither should appear as operating until passenger service is officially confirmed.
Dela Rosa should not be aliased to future NSCR Buendia, and Pasay Road has no named direct NSCR successor in the current station set.
completenessDoctrine: Current service status and physical-infrastructure existence are separate dimensions.
A headline count is not permission to invent unnamed points.
Do not count current national/operator supplemental assets against a Makati city denominator without source-backed equivalence.
Do not render linear routes as a single point merely to claim coverage.
Historical names and current successor services must be crosswalked, not merged by proximity alone.
